name: LeadGen AI - Phase 5 Lead Capture & Gemini AI Generation Pipeline

nodes.name: Google Sheets Trigger
nodes.notes: Triggers on newly appended row in linked Google Form response spreadsheet. Do not hardcode credentials.

nodes.name: Normalize Lead Data
nodes.notes: Trims whitespace, normalizes email to lowercase, and preserves spreadsheet row number

nodes.name: Check Duplicate in FastAPI
nodes.notes: Queries FastAPI database to verify if email already exists

nodes.name: FastAPI Ingestion (lead-capture)
nodes.notes: Submits validated lead to FastAPI SQLite database and assigns deterministic priority

nodes.name: Gemini AI Generation
nodes.notes: Calls official Google Gemini API with system instructions and untrusted input protection

nodes.name: Validate Structured JSON
nodes.notes: Strict validation of subject, body, and summary non-empty string fields

nodes.name: Save Generated Draft in FastAPI
nodes.notes: Persists generated draft to EmailRecord in Draft status with idempotent duplicate prevention

nodes.name: Google Sheets Update (Success)
nodes.notes: Updates original spreadsheet row with generated fields, Completed status, and Draft / Not Sent

nodes.name: Google Sheets Update (AI Failed)
nodes.notes: Logs AI processing failures without overwriting form input or sending emails

nodes.name: Google Sheets Update (Duplicate)
nodes.notes: Marks duplicate row to prevent duplicate lead processing

nodes.name: Google Sheets Update (Invalid)
nodes.notes: Logs validation failure reasons to spreadsheet for manual correction
